title: Low blood sugar
plain: Blood sugar is dangerously low. The brain needs sugar now: give fast sugar first, then check it is working.

steps.text: Call the crew medical officer and a crewmate now. Stay with the person.
Check if it is safe to swallow
steps.question: Is the person fully awake and able to swallow safely?

steps.detail: No tablets? 150 mL of fruit juice or regular soda works too.
70 mg/dL or more means it is working. Below 70: give fast sugar again.

steps.text: Eat a snack with starch and protein (for example crackers with peanut butter)
steps.detail: This keeps the sugar from dropping again. Rest for the next hour.
Use this when the person cannot swallow safely or fast sugar did not work.

steps.text: Turn the person on their side (recovery position). Nothing by mouth until fully awake.
When fully awake and able to swallow: give fast sugar, then a snack

escalation: Still low after fast sugar twice and glucagon, or not waking up: keep the person on their side, follow EMG-LOW-GLUCOSE with the CMO, give oxygen by the checklist and measure every 5 minutes. Earth is informed.
